title: Afternoon digest
intro: Nothing urgent. One reply ready for your approval, one task due today. 3 earlier items answered since 11:30.
spoken: Nothing urgent. One thing to answer: Lee at Client B asks whether Thursday's review can move to Friday, and a reply is ready. Still open from this morning: the school asks for the signed trip form, due today. Acme is quiet. Calendar: one meeting at 16:00, and dinner with Jamie at 19:00. Nobody you're waiting on is overdue.

items.headline: Lee asks to move Thursday's review to Friday

items.subject: Review Thursday?

draft.text:
Hi Lee,

Friday 10:00 works for me – I'll move the invite.

br Alex
